signature.name: VTask.isoMk
signature.type:
{R : Type u} -> [Ring R] -> {M N : ModuleCat R} -> (φ : (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (ModuleCat R) Ab).obj M ≅ (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (ModuleCat R) Ab).obj N) -> (hφ :
    ∀ (r : R),
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp φ.hom (N.smul r) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (M.smul r) φ.hom) -> M ≅ N

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.isoMk is a total constructor; every well-typed input yields a valid isomorphism in ModuleCat R, so there are no junk-value or edge conventions to record.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Ring R] {M N : ModuleCat R} (φ : (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (ModuleCat R) Ab).obj M ≅ (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (ModuleCat R) Ab).obj N) (hφ : ∀ r : R, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp φ.hom (N.smul r) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (M.smul r) φ.hom), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (VTask.isoMk φ hφ).hom (VTask.isoMk φ hφ).inv = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id M
